tagline.value: Forecasting software that keeps distributed energy grids stable.

sector.note: Inferred from grid forecasting SaaS positioning

sub_sector.value: Grid forecasting SaaS for electric distribution utilities

problem.value: US utilities curtailed 8.2 TWh of renewables in 2025 (est. $1.4B cost) because they cannot forecast distributed solar and battery output hour-by-hour; legacy SCADA forecasting tools were built for centralised thermal plants.

solution.value: Ingests smart-meter and inverter telemetry to produce 15-minute-resolution per-feeder generation forecasts, delivered as a read-only SaaS layer alongside existing SCADA - no utility hardware, no control-plane integration, no NERC CIP scope.

business_model.value: Annual SaaS subscription priced per feeder under management; average contract value $155K; land-and-expand from one district to full service territory; 81% gross margin.

go_to_market.value: Direct sales to utilities with land-and-expand within service territories; pilot pipeline sourced via the EPRI distribution working group; hiring 5 utility-sales reps.

value: SOC 2 Type II and utility security review (20%)

value.label: Pilot pipeline
value.value: 11 utilities via EPRI distribution working group

market_note.value: TAM $750M bottom-up (3,000 US distribution utilities x $250K ACV); SAM $105M (420 utilities with >5% DG penetration). TAM ACV assumption exceeds current $155K ACV.
